{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows where either flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g is missing
complete_pairs = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Compute the Pearson correlation
correlation = complete_pairs['flipper_length_mm'].corr(complete_pairs['body_mass_g'])

# Print the correlation value with 3 decimal places to match the precision of the final answer
print(f'{correlation:.3f}')"}
